evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.973 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure reached 3.228 Torr despite stable Ar at 99.8 sccm and temperature at 750.2 C; this departs from the earlier approximately 3 Torr baseline.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 sensor is needed to verify the atmosphere; pressure acceptance limits and independent pressure, leak, and exhaust-conductance checks are needed to identify the cause of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
